title: Open Food Log v0: recipe
description: A food made of other foods: its ingredient lines, shaped like meal items, what the whole makes, and how many servings. A meal item names it by its id like any food. Its nutrients follow from its lines (section 8 of the spec). v0.1; may change until v1.

id.description: namespace:slug. recipe: is one person's recipe, meaningful only inside the system that made it; a publisher uses its own namespace.

instructions.description: How to make it, as free text.

lines.description: The ingredients, raw as they went in, each like a meal item: the person's words, the food, the amount, its grams and what it held.

servings.description: How many servings the whole makes. One serving weighs yield_g / servings.

yield_g.description: What the whole weighs when made (cooked pasta takes up water, a roast loses it). Absent means the lines' grams times cooking_yield_factor, or the lines' grams when there's no factor either.

cooking_yield_factor.description: Made weight over the lines' raw weight (0.75 for a roast that loses a quarter of its weight). Used only when yield_g is absent. Cooking changes weight; OFL doesn't adjust nutrients for what cooking destroys.

nutrients_per_100g.description: Worked out from the lines: their summed nutrients × 100 / yield_g. A producer may include it; a reader may recompute it. A nutrient one line lacks is left out, since the sum would be a lower bound.

nutrients_per_serving.description: Worked out from the lines: their summed nutrients / servings, under the same rule.

estimates.description: JSON pointers to values inferred or assumed rather than given, as in a meal.
